Method of Attack: File wiping malware that deletes files and causes system to become unbootable
Locks the device's Master Boot Record (MBR)
Installs a screen locker that prevents access to the device
Batch files check for antivirus, disconnect device from network, add Windows Defender exclusions, clear event logs, delete scheduled tasks, flush filesystem cache, and launch malware components
Impacted Systems: Windows devices on the Iranian railway network
Attack Vector: RAR archive extracted with password 'hackemall' placed on network share accessible to railway network computers
Windows group policies configured to launch setup.bat batch file on local devices
Indicators of Compromise: Screen locker wallpaper displayed before reboot
Overlap of nti.exe MBR locker with NotPetya wiper MBR corruption method
